result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: truncated restaurant names and category chips, partial cards cut off at edges, and uneven spacing that make the feed look broken.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters at the end of the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure horizontal cards fully show names (e.g. ellipsis with full name on detail).

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow horizontally; the last visible chip ('Healthy') is cut off and further options are only partially shown.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal scroll padding/fade, ensure chips aren’t clipped, or wrap/reflow filters on smaller widths.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is heavily clipped on the right edge so image and delivery time badge are incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel peek/padding so partial cards still look intentional, or snap so full cards are primary with consistent margins.

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is cut off mid-image by the tab bar with no clear fade or spacing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding above the tab bar so cards aren’t abruptly clipped.

issues.description: Promo banner text is low-contrast light green on light green, reducing readability of the offer details.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary promo text or increase contrast against the soft green background.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit with inconsistent vertical alignment over the food images across the three fastest cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge position and image crop so all cards share the same visual rhythm.
